thread:
Noah (AE): Medisync procurement paused the PO. They need SOC2 cover page, ISO scope excerpt, a signed pen-test confirmation, and confirmation we can run a 48h external scan against an isolated staging tenant before they sign.
Ivy (SE): We can stand up an isolated tenant. Need their scanner IPs and expected peak RPS. If traffic >150 rps sustained, pricing will need a reserved burst.
Arjun (Security): We have a standard pen-test confirmation template. Legal must approve signer. We can provide SOC2 cover page + redacted ISO scope. Remediation history: provide summary table only.
Noah (AE): They asked the attestation to cite remediation of critical/high findings in last 12 months. Is summary table acceptable?
Arjun (Security): Yes 3 provide date, severity, short remediation summary, and internal ref. No raw tickets or PII.
Ivy (SE): For authenticated scans we can issue short-lived service creds (48h TTL) and rotate afterward. We'll stream readonly logs to a bucket. We can't turn off audit logging.
Noah (AE): Procurement also wants tester insurance cert and a named tester. Legal okay with NDA addendum?
Diane (Legal): We can add a one-page SOW/NDA addendum limiting liability during the scan. If they want an officer-level signature on the attestation, need exec approval.
Ivy (SE): Recommend synthetic test data or presigned object with tight expiry + IP restriction. Example snippet:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-temp/medisync-test.tar.gz --expires-in 900
# apply bucket policy to only allow GET from their CIDRs
```
Arjun (Security): Also require a signed test-plan (allowed vectors) and insurance cert from the tester (cyber liability). No kernel/firmware fuzzing without an engineering maintenance window.
ops-bot: Created ticket SLS-7802: "Medisync evidence + staging-scan coordination" assigned to Arjun (Security). Priority: high.
Ivy (SE): Ballpark cost impact: +10-18% on Dedicated quote for reserved burst and ops standby for a 48h external scan. I'll firm up once they share IPs & qps.
Noah (AE): Action items: Arjun -> attach SOC2 + ISO excerpt + draft attestation; Diane -> draft SOW addendum and review signer clause; Ivy -> runbook and cost delta; I'll ask Medisync for tester name, insurance, CIDRs, and test plan.
Noah (AE): Customer asked for the window next Tue-Wed. Can we tentatively commit?
Ivy (SE): Tentative yes pending infra capacity confirmation. I'll ping infra after we have qps.
Diane (Legal): I'll draft SOW addendum and circulate. If they need exec-signed attestation, flag me and I'll start approvals.
Noah (AE): Thanks team 1 will update the buyer and push for tester certs. :thumbsup:
